message: Last summer, I experienced my first big blackout while hosting a game night. Just as we were about to start a thrilling round of charades, the lights flickered and went out! I scrambled to find my trusty power bank, but the frantic search made me realize my phone was on its last legs. Thankfully, I had some flashlights and a lantern ready to go, so we lit up the room and kept the fun alive. It taught me the value of keeping my devices charged and having backup light sources handy. What’s your go-to tip for staying comfy during a power outage?
